value.rationale: The gap between an L2 stability CFL and a discrete maximum-principle CFL is a practically motivated safety distinction for explicit phase-field stepping, quantified on natural all-n triangular graphs by the sharp asymptotic 3/2 factor. It provides explicit finite negative transition and exact nonlinear cube-violation witnesses, a structural criterion for every regular graph, and clarifies why energy stability does not guarantee positivity. No speedup or claim for higher stages is inferred.
